subtitle: Old Root
briefing: The opened migration trail leads to Old Root, where the thorncallers have kept apart from the packs. Merek’s garrison blocks the marsh causeway beyond it. Ash-Muzzle can claim the empty grove to call thorncallers at the nearby keep; breaking the garrison will let the whole grove join him.

intro.text: Sedge’s trail brought us here before Merek. There is still time to bring Old Root into our company.

dialogue.text: Their spears hold the dry bank. My shields can meet them, but the wolves will bleed if they rush that line.

alternative.text: Their spears hold the dry bank. Put shields before the wolves; use the marsh to reach their archers.

intro.text: I will claim the grove above the marsh. Thorncallers can gather at the keep beside it and trade shots with those archers while our shields cross.
No beast crosses this causeway. Hold them apart until the chief arrives.
We break that garrison. Then no pack has to ask Merek’s leave to reach Old Root.

victory.text: You have made a road for all of us, not just Yara’s groves. My thorncallers will march with your packs.
Bring them to the valley mouth. Merek came here expecting separate dens to frighten. Let him meet one company.

debrief: The causeway is open. Old Root’s thorncallers join the packs and make their ranged attacks available for the final battle. Merek’s own camp still bars the valley mouth.
